subject: Insurance
title: The Titanic's Insurance Legacy
description: A fast breakdown of The Titanic's Insurance Legacy for builders.

hook.text: The Titanic's hull was insured for $5 million at Lloyd's of London.

buildup.text: Lloyd's syndicate members faced devastating losses. Some were ruined.

discovery.text: Passenger lawsuits were limited to $97,000 total under maritime law.

twist.text: The disaster forced new safety regulations: enough lifeboats for everyone, mandatory radio watch, and ice patrol routes.

climax.text: The Titanic changed maritime insurance forever. Underwriters demanded higher safety standards before writing policies.

punchline.text: $5 million claim, 1,500 dead. The Titanic rewrote maritime insurance rules.

quiz.question: How did the Titanic affect maritime insurance?
